parameters.query:
select id as "ID_Transaksi",
       occurred_at::text as "Tanggal",
       kind as "Jenis",
       category as "Kategori",
       amount::float8 as "Nominal",
       note as "Keterangan",
       account_id as "Dompet"
from public.transactions
where deleted_at is null
order by occurred_at desc, id desc

nodes.name: Konteks Python - Hitung Rekap Bulanan
nodes.notes: Menyediakan data lintas node untuk Code node Python Native.

parameters.pythonCode:
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

month = (_items[0].get("json") or {}).get("normal", {}).get("bulan", "") if _items else ""
def amount_of(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool): return None
    if isinstance(value, int): return value
    digits = re.sub(r"[^\d]", "", str(value or ""))
    try: return int(digits) if digits else None
    except ValueError: return None
income = expense = count = 0
for item in _items:
    row = item.get("json") or {}
    if str(row.get("Tanggal") or "")[:7] != month: continue
    amount = amount_of(row.get("Nominal"))
    if amount is None or amount < 1: continue
    if row.get("Jenis") == "Pemasukan": income += amount
    elif row.get("Jenis") == "Pengeluaran": expense += amount
    else: continue
    count += 1
def money(value): return ("-Rp" if value < 0 else "Rp") + f"{abs(value):,}".replace(",", ".")
return [{"json": {"output": f"Rekap {month} (WIB)\n{count} transaksi\nPemasukan {money(income)}\nPengeluaran {money(expense)}\nSelisih {money(income-expense)}"}}]
